title: `The plan step covering now` is written four times; two copies have no end rule and hold the last step forever
claim: coordinator._covering_index and pump_arbiter._step_index answer `no step` once now is past the plan's last step, while pump_arbiter._planned_room and early_cutoff._planned_room keep returning the last step's value at any later instant (4 of 8 shared probes disagree, from the last step's end edge to a day past it).
mechanism: All four start from bisect_right(timestamps, now) - 1. _covering_index (coordinator.py:591) and _step_index (pump_arbiter.py:543) add the half-open end of the last step (R10 N-no-expiry, #2229); the two _planned_room copies bound the index only by the series' length. Their callers are gated on plan_stale (age over three solve cycles) at pump_arbiter.py:1421 and early_cutoff.py:224, and ungated at pump_arbiter.py:632, 654, 1454 and 1646; a plan's horizon outlasts the stale limit on every shipped configuration, so no wrong write was produced here -- the copies disagree, and the class's barrier does not cover them.

evidence.unit: probes of 8 on which the four implementations do not agree whether a step covers now
evidence.machine: Apple M1 (8 cores), Darwin 27.2.0 arm64, Python 3.14.7 (venv-ci)
evidence.contention_note: shared box during the fan-out, load1 150-270; the number is a static or behavioural count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: attribute swap of pump_arbiter._planned_room and early_cutoff._planned_room for bodies that take their index from pump_arbiter._step_index (m8_agree.py --only step_covering_now --perturb)

metric_definition: probes (an instant relative to an 8-step plan) at which {_covering_index, _step_index, arbiter._planned_room, early_cutoff._planned_room} disagree on `a step covers now`
phenomenon_property: Every reader of `the plan step covering now` takes its index from one function with the half-open end rule; no reader indexes a plan series from a bare bisect.

null_control.note: the four probes inside the plan (before, first, mid, last) agree in the same run

proposed_fix_scope: pump_arbiter._planned_room and early_cutoff._planned_room index through pump_arbiter._step_index (or coordinator._covering_index moved to a leaf both import); pump_arbiter.py:1942's bare bisect with them. One owner: the step-index function.
